TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will staff this HMIS program with a dedicated delivery team combining hospital IT implementation experience, certified project governance, and audited quality/security management systems. We are SECP incorporated and maintain FBR National Tax Number with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, meeting the Department’s mandatory eligibility expectations for compliant contracting and invoicing [CO-PROFILE].

Certifications and governance: We hold ISO 27001 for information security management and will apply it to HMIS controls such as role-based access, audit trails, and encryption governance across environments and interfaces [CO-PROFILE]. We also hold ISO 9001, providing a structured quality management system for requirements traceability, configuration control, testing sign-offs, and change management throughout rollout across four tertiary-care sites [CO-PROFILE]. Our software delivery maturity is evidenced through CMMI Level 3 [CO-PROFILE], including successful delivery of hospital IT deployments under CMMI L3-governed programs [CAP-006]. Project governance will be led by a PMP-certified project manager; we maintain six PMP-certified PMs in-house [CO-PROFILE].

Healthcare delivery evidence: Within the last five years, we have completed multiple hospital IT deployments, including a Provincial Government hospital IT deployment completed in 2023 [CAP-018] and an international hospital IT deployment completed in 2022 under ISO 9001 governance [CAP-030].

Quality assurance and readiness gaps: The RFP requires CMMI Level 5; our library evidences CMMI Level 3, not Level 5 [CO-PROFILE]. We will close this mandatory gap through an appraised Level-5 partner for software development oversight and independent process audits during implementation.

Support and training: Our delivery footprint includes an in-country support desk model with defined response SLAs and preventive maintenance on O&M contracts [CO-PROFILE]. For this engagement, we will staff a 24/7 help desk and deliver structured end-user/admin training at scale, leveraging our established training and rollout practices from prior deployments [CO-PROFILE].
